title: Senior ML Engineer
summary: Lead the development of production ML pipelines and model deployment infrastructure for enterprise clients.
description: We are looking for a Senior ML Engineer to design and build end-to-end ML systems. You will work closely with data scientists and product teams to bring AI models from research to production at scale.
requirements: 5+ years experience in ML engineering or related field
Experience with ML Ops (MLflow, Kubeflow, or similar)
Cloud platforms (AWS SageMaker, Azure ML, or GCP Vertex)
Experience deploying models at scale (Docker, Kubernetes)
niceToHave: Experience with LLMs and RAG pipelines
Background in NLP or Computer Vision

title: GenAI Solutions Architect
summary: Architect and deliver GenAI solutions including RAG pipelines, AI copilots, and custom LLM deployments for enterprise clients.
description: As a GenAI Solutions Architect, you will design end-to-end generative AI systems for our clients. This includes building RAG architectures, fine-tuning LLMs, implementing guardrails, and ensuring production reliability.
requirements: 4+ years in AI/ML with focus on NLP or GenAI
Hands-on experience with OpenAI API, Azure OpenAI, or similar
Experience building RAG systems (vector DBs, embeddings, retrieval)
Understanding of AI safety and responsible AI practices
niceToHave: Experience with LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar frameworks
Background in enterprise search or knowledge management
Published research or blog posts on GenAI topics

title: Robotics Software Engineer
summary: Develop software for industrial robotics systems including path planning, computer vision, and real-time control.
description: Join our Robotics team to build cutting-edge software for industrial robots. You will work on perception, planning, and control systems for manufacturing and logistics automation.
requirements: Understanding of kinematics, dynamics, and motion planning

title: Data Analytics Intern
summary: Support the analytics team with data analysis, dashboard creation, and client reporting.
description: A 6-month internship where you will work alongside senior analysts on real client projects. You will build dashboards, clean datasets, and help derive insights from marketing and customer data.
requirements: Currently pursuing or recently completed degree in Data Science, Statistics, CS, or related
Familiarity with data visualization (Tableau, Power BI, or similar)
niceToHave: Experience with pandas, numpy, or similar libraries
Interest in AI and machine learning
